verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents an official MCP server that agents/clients can connect to, with tool calls to 3,000+ APIs, built-in authentication handling, and a remote server endpoint any MCP client can point to. This is corroborated by dedicated docs, homepage messaging, and an independent probe confirming the documented server. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation that the MCP server works reliably in production beyond vendor docs.
